description: List the event's speakers (up to 200): speaker roster members and presenters on accepted sessions, never unapproved applicants. Use it for who is speaking at this event; use list_associated_contacts for one person's assistants or colleagues. Returns speakers[] with contactId, name, title, company, sessionTitles, and confirmed, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_speakers

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
